questions.question: Choose the correct article: She is ___ honest girl who always speaks the truth.
questions.explanation: शब्द 'honest' को सुरुवात व्यञ्जन वर्ण 'h' बाट भए तापनि यसको उच्चारण स्वर ध्वनि (अनेस्ट) बाट हुने भएकाले अनिश्चित एकवचन नामको अगाडि 'an' उपपद (article) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: Our school starts ___ 10 o'clock in the morning.
questions.explanation: घडीको निश्चित समय (clock time) जनाउन अङ्ग्रेजी व्याकरणमा सधैँ 'at' नामयोगी (preposition) को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Add the correct question tag: They play football every evening, ___?
questions.explanation: दिइएको वाक्य वर्तमान काल (Simple Present Tense) को करण (affirmative) रूप र बहुवचन कर्ता 'They' मा भएकाले सहायक क्रिया 'do' बाट अकरण बनाई 'don't they' ट्याग प्रश्न राखिन्छ।

questions.question: Supply the correct tense of the verb: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
questions.explanation: वाक्यको सुरुमा 'Look!' जस्ता विस्मयादिबोधक शब्द आउँदा कार्य बोलेकै समयमा भइरहेको बुझिने हुँदा अपूर्ण वर्तमान काल (Present Continuous Tense: is/am/are + V4) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb for subject-verb agreement: Either Ram or his friends ___ broken this window.
questions.explanation: Either...or' ले जोडिएका दुई कर्ताहरूमध्ये क्रियाभन्दा नजिकको कर्ता 'his friends' बहुवचन (plural) भएकाले बहुवचन क्रिया 'have' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct affirmative transformation of: 'She did not buy anything from the market.'
options: She bought something from the market.
She bought nothing from the market.
She buys something from the market.
She has bought something from the market.
questions.option_a: She bought something from the market.
questions.option_b: She bought nothing from the market.
questions.option_c: She buys something from the market.
questions.option_d: She has bought something from the market.
questions.explanation: सामान्य भूतकाल (did not + V1) को अकरण वाक्यलाई करण (affirmative) मा बदल्दा क्रियाको दोस्रो रूप (V2: bought) प्रयोग गरिन्छ र 'anything' लाई 'something' मा परिवर्तन गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Identify the correct passive voice of: 'Ramesh writes a letter.'
options: A letter was written by Ramesh.
A letter is being written by Ramesh.
A letter is written by Ramesh.
A letter has been written by Ramesh.
questions.option_a: A letter was written by Ramesh.
questions.option_b: A letter is being written by Ramesh.
questions.option_c: A letter is written by Ramesh.
questions.option_d: A letter has been written by Ramesh.
questions.explanation: सामान्य वर्तमान काल (Subject + V1/V5 + Object) लाई कर्मवाच्य (Passive Voice) मा बदल्दा 'Object + is/am/are + V3 + by + Subject' को संरचना अनुसार 'A letter is written by Ramesh' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect speech of: He said, "I am very busy today."
options: He said that he is very busy today.
He said that he was very busy that day.
He told that he was very busy today.
He said that I was very busy that day.
questions.option_a: He said that he is very busy today.
questions.option_b: He said that he was very busy that day.
questions.option_c: He told that he was very busy today.
questions.option_d: He said that I was very busy that day.
questions.explanation: प्रत्यक्ष कथनलाई अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा बदल्दा भूतकालको रिपोर्टिङ क्रिया (said) का कारण 'am' लाई 'was' मा र समय सूचक शब्द 'today' लाई 'that day' मा परिवर्तन गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the conditional sentence: If you heat ice, it ___ into water.
questions.explanation: वैज्ञानिक सत्य वा सर्वकालिक तथ्य (Zero Conditional) जनाउने सर्तवाचक वाक्यमा दुवै खण्ड सामान्य वर्तमान काल (Simple Present Tense) मा हुने भएकाले एकवचन कर्ता 'it' सँग 'melts' (V5) लाग्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the correct connective: ___ he was unwell, he attended the examination.
questions.explanation: परस्पर विरोधी भाव वा असंगति (contrast) जनाउने पूर्ण उपवाक्य (clause: Subject + Verb) को अगाडि 'Although' वा 'Even though' संयोजक प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct causative verb form: I made my brother ___ my shoes.
questions.explanation: प्रेरणादायक क्रिया (Causative verb) 'make' को पछाडि सजीव कारक (agent: my brother) आउँदा क्रियाको मूल रूप (bare infinitive / V1: clean) मात्र प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The boy ___ won the first prize is my cousin.
questions.explanation: मानिस (human antecedent: The boy) लाई जनाउन र उपवाक्यमा कर्ता (subject) को काम गर्न सम्बन्धवाचक सर्वनाम 'who' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Find the correct synonym of the word 'ABUNDANT':
questions.explanation: Abundant' को अर्थ प्रशस्त वा प्रचुर मात्रामा उपलब्ध हुनु हो, जसको समानार्थी शब्द (synonym) 'Plentiful' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Find the correct antonym of the word 'OPTIMISTIC':
questions.explanation: Optimistic' (आशावादी) शब्दको विपरीतार्थी शब्द (antonym) 'Pessimistic' (निराशावादी) हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct article: ___ Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world.
questions.explanation: एक्ला हिमाल वा चुचुराहरूको नाम (single peaks like Mount Everest, Mount Machhapuchhre) को अगाडि कुनै पनि उपपद (article) प्रयोग गरिँदैन; हिमशृङ्खला (The Himalayas) मा मात्र 'the' लाग्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: Sita has been living in Pokhara ___ 2018.
questions.explanation: पूर्ण अपूर्ण कालमा निश्चित सुरुवाती समय (point of time जस्तै सन् २०१८) जनाउन 'since' र समयको अवधि (period of time) जनाउन 'for' प्रयोग हुन्छ; तर प्रश्नमा उत्तर सन्तुलनका लागि: 'Sita has been living in Pokhara ___ five years' मान्दा समयको अवधिमा 'for' प्रयोग गरिन्छ (नोट: २००८ देखि २०१८ सम्मको कुल अवधि वा निश्चित वर्ष बाहेकको अवधिमा 'for' र निश्चित वर्षमा 'since' लाग्ने नियम अनुसार यहाँ अवधिको अर्थमा विकल्प A वा बिंदुको अर्थमा B हेर्दा: सही मिलानका लागि यदि खाली ठाउँ पछाडि अवधि छ भने 'for' नै सही हुन्छ)।

questions.question: Add the correct question tag: I am right, ___?
questions.explanation: अङ्ग्रेजी व्याकरणको नियम अनुसार 'I am' बाट सुरु हुने सकारात्मक वाक्यको प्रश्न ट्याग (Question Tag) मा 'amn't I' को सट्टा मानक रूपमा 'aren't I' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: The Earth ___ round the Sun.
questions.explanation: ध्रुवसत्य वा प्राकृतिक नियम (universal truth) जनाउने वाक्य सधैँ सामान्य वर्तमान कालमा हुने र कर्ता 'The Earth' एकवचन भएकाले क्रियाको पाँचौँ रूप 'moves' (V5) प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb: Slow and steady ___ the race.
questions.explanation: Slow and steady' नामक पदावलीले एउटै साझा भाव वा विचार (single idea/unit) व्यक्त गर्ने भएकाले यसले एकवचन क्रिया 'wins' लिन्छ।

questions.question: Change into negative: 'He always comes here on time.'
options: He never comes here on time.
He does not never come here on time.
He always does not come here on time.
He did not come here on time.
questions.option_a: He never comes here on time.
questions.option_b: He does not never come here on time.
questions.option_c: He always does not come here on time.
questions.option_d: He did not come here on time.
questions.explanation: करण वाक्यमा रहेको क्रियाविशेषण 'always' लाई अकरण (negative) मा बदल्दा सहायक क्रिया नराखी सिधै 'never' मा बदलिन्छ र मूल क्रियाको रूप (comes) यथावत् राखिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct passive form of: 'Open the door.'
options: The door is opened by you.
questions.option_d: The door is opened by you.
questions.explanation: आज्ञार्थक वाक्य (Imperative sentence: V1 + Object) लाई कर्मवाच्यमा बदल्दा 'Let + Object + be + V3' को सूत्र अनुसार 'Let the door be opened' बनाइन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the conditional sentence: If I had a lot of money, I ___ buy a new house.
questions.explanation: अवास्तविक वर्तमान वा काल्पनिक अवस्था (Second Conditional: If + Subject + V2) हुँदा मुख्य उपवाक्यमा 'Subject + would/could/might + V1' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: My father always goes to his office ___ foot.
questions.explanation: सवारी साधनको नाम अगाडि 'by' (by bus, by car) लागे तापनि पैदल हिँडेर जाने अर्थमा सधैँ 'on foot' भन्ने स्थिर पदावली (fixed phrase) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct connective: She stayed at home ___ heavy rainfall.
questions.explanation: कारण जनाउने नाम पदावली (Noun phrase: heavy rainfall) को अगाडि संयोजकका रूपमा 'because of' वा 'due to' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ भने उपवाक्यको अगाडि मात्र 'because' लाग्छ।

questions.question: Supply the correct form of verb after causative: Gita got her hair ___ yesterday.
questions.explanation: प्रेरणादायक क्रिया 'get' पछाडि निर्जीव कर्म (object: her hair) आउँदा क्रियाको तेस्रो रूप (Past Participle / V3) प्रयोग हुन्छ र 'cut' को तेस्रो रूप पनि 'cut' नै हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct modal verb: Look at those dark clouds; it ___ rain soon.
questions.explanation: वर्तमानको लक्षण वा प्रमाणका आधारमा भविष्यको सम्भावना (possibility) व्यक्त गर्न मोडल क्रिया 'may' को प्रयोग उपयुक्त हुन्छ।

questions.question: Which one is a one-word substitution for 'A person who cannot read and write'?
questions.explanation: पढ्न र लेख्न नसक्ने व्यक्तिलाई एक शब्दमा 'Illiterate' (निरक्षर) भनिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct reflex pronoun for the tag/sentence: We enjoyed ___ at the picnic yesterday.
questions.explanation: प्रथम पुरुष बहुवचन कर्ता 'We' सँग आत्मवाचक सर्वनाम (reflexive pronoun) का रूपमा 'ourselves' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct article: My brother studies in ___ university in Kathmandu.
questions.explanation: University' शब्दको सुरुको अक्षर स्वर वर्ण 'u' भए तापनि यसको उच्चारण व्यञ्जन ध्वनि 'यु' (yoo) बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले यसको अगाडि 'a' उपपद लाग्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct concord: Ten kilometres ___ a long distance to walk on foot.
questions.explanation: दूरी, समय, तौल वा रकम जनाउने बहुवचन नामहरूले एउटै एकीकृत परिमाण (single unit of measurement) बुझाउँदा एकवचन क्रिया 'is' लिन्छन्।

questions.question: Supply the correct question tag: Let's go for a morning walk, ___?
questions.explanation: प्रस्ताव जनाउने 'Let's' (Let us) बाट सुरु भएका आज्ञार्थक वाक्यहरूमा प्रश्न ट्याग सधैँ 'shall we' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: The cat jumped ___ the table from the floor.
questions.explanation: एक सतहबाट अर्को सतहमा गतिशील भई माथि जाने कार्य (movement towards a surface) जनाउन 'onto' नामयोगीको प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct tense: When I reached the station, the train ___.
questions.explanation: भूतकालमा घटेका दुई घटनाहरूमध्ये पहिले नै सम्पन्न भइसकेको कार्यलाई पूर्ण भूतकाल (Past Perfect Tense: had + V3) र पछि भएको कार्यलाई सामान्य भूतकाल (V2) मा राखिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct verb for subject-verb agreement: A number of students ___ absent from the class today.
questions.explanation: A number of + बहुवचन नाम' ले अनिश्चित तर धेरै संख्या जनाउने हुँदा सधैँ बहुवचन क्रिया (are) लिन्छ भने 'The number of' ले एकवचन क्रिया लिन्छ।

questions.question: Transform into indirect speech: The teacher said to me, "Where do you live?"
options: The teacher asked me where I lived.
The teacher asked me where did I live.
The teacher told me where I lived.
The teacher asked me where do you live.
questions.option_a: The teacher asked me where I lived.
questions.option_b: The teacher asked me where did I live.
questions.option_c: The teacher told me where I lived.
questions.option_d: The teacher asked me where do you live.
questions.explanation: प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य (Wh-question) लाई अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा लैजाँदा प्रश्नको संरचनालाई सामान्य विवरण (Subject + Verb: where I lived) मा बदलिन्छ र सहायक क्रिया 'do' हटेर मूल क्रिया V2 बन्छ।

questions.question: Change into passive voice: 'People believe that he is a spy.'
options: He is believed that he is a spy.
That he is a spy is believed by people.
He is believed to be a spy.
He was believed to be a spy.
questions.option_a: He is believed that he is a spy.
questions.option_b: That he is a spy is believed by people.
questions.option_c: He is believed to be a spy.
questions.option_d: He was believed to be a spy.
questions.explanation: People believe/say/think that...' जस्ता वाक्यलाई कर्मवाच्यमा बदल्दा 'It is believed that...' वा कर्तालाई अगाडि ल्याई 'Subject + is/am/are + V3 + to-infinitive (He is believed to be a spy)' बनाइन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct causative form: The teacher had the students ___ the entire essay again.
questions.explanation: प्रेरणादायक क्रिया 'have' (भूतकाल 'had') को पछाडि सजीव कारक (the students) आउँदा 'make' जस्तै क्रियाको मूल रूप (bare infinitive / V1: write) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the conditional sentence: Had you worked hard, you ___ the examination.
questions.explanation: यो तेस्रो प्रकारको सर्तवाचक वाक्य (Third Conditional) को 'If' लुप्त भएको (Inverted: Had + Subject + V3) रूप हो; तसर्थ मुख्य उपवाक्यमा 'would have + V3' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct articles: ___ flute is ___ musical instrument.
questions.explanation: कुनै पनि वाद्ययन्त्र (musical instrument जस्तै flute, guitar, piano) को नामको अगाडि नियमपूर्वक निश्चित उपपद 'The' प्रयोग गरिन्छ र गणनावाचक एकवचन नाम 'musical instrument' को अगाडि 'a' लाग्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: Nothing went wrong during the program, ___?
questions.explanation: कर्ताको स्थानमा 'Nothing' (अकरण शब्द) र निर्जीव वस्तु जनाउने सर्वनाम हुने हुँदा प्रश्न ट्याग सकारात्मक 'did it' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Supply the correct tense: By the end of this year, she ___ here for ten years.
questions.explanation: भविष्यको निश्चित समयसम्म (By + future time) कुनै कार्य निरन्तर चलिरहेको समयावधि पूरा हुने अवस्था बुझाउन पूर्ण अपूर्ण भविष्यत् काल (Future Perfect Continuous: will have been + V4) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb: The Principal, along with all the teachers, ___ present at the meeting.
questions.explanation: दुई कर्ताहरू 'along with', 'together with', वा 'as well as' ले जोडिँदा पहिलो कर्ता (The Principal - एकवचन) अनुसार क्रिया 'is' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct Wh-question for the statement: 'They went to Pokhara to spend their holidays.'
options: Why did they go to Pokhara?
Where did they go for holidays?
How did they go to Pokhara?
When did they go to Pokhara?
questions.option_a: Why did they go to Pokhara?
questions.option_b: Where did they go for holidays?
questions.option_c: How did they go to Pokhara?
questions.option_d: When did they go to Pokhara?
questions.explanation: वाक्यमा रहेको उद्देश्य सूचक पदावली 'to spend their holidays' (बिदा मनाउनका लागि) लाई हटाएर प्रश्न निर्माण गर्दा कारण वा उद्देश्य सोध्ने प्रश्नवाचक शब्द 'Why' र सामान्य भूतकालको 'did + V1' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct connective: Walk carefully ___ you should fall down on the slippery road.
questions.explanation: भविष्यको सम्भावित नकारात्मक नतिजाबाट सचेत गराउने अर्थमा ('नत्र भने... होला' भन्ने अर्थमा) खाली ठाउँ पछाडि 'should + V1' छ भने सधैँ 'lest' संयोजकको प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct passive voice of: 'Who taught you English?'
options: By whom were you taught English?
By whom you were taught English?
Whom were you taught English by?
questions.option_b: By whom were you taught English?
questions.option_c: By whom you were taught English?
questions.option_d: Whom were you taught English by?
questions.explanation: Who' बाट सुरु हुने भूतकालको प्रश्नलाई कर्मवाच्यमा बदल्दा प्रश्नकै संरचना कायम राखी 'By whom + was/were + Object + V3...?' (By whom were you taught English?) बनाइन्छ।

questions.question: Transform into indirect speech: He said, "Let's organize a blood donation camp."
options: He asked to organize a blood donation camp.
He ordered that they should organize a blood donation camp.
He suggested organizing a blood donation camp.
He said that let us organize a blood donation camp.
questions.option_a: He asked to organize a blood donation camp.
questions.option_b: He ordered that they should organize a blood donation camp.
questions.option_c: He suggested organizing a blood donation camp.
questions.option_d: He said that let us organize a blood donation camp.
questions.explanation: प्रत्यक्ष कथनमा 'Let's' ले सुझाव वा प्रस्ताव जनाउने हुँदा अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा 'suggested + V4 (gerund)' वा 'suggested that they should + V1' को संरचना प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the correct preposition: The old man died ___ cancer last week.
questions.explanation: कुनै पनि रोग (disease जस्तै cancer, cholera) का कारण मृत्यु भएको जनाउन 'die' क्रिया पछाडि सधैँ 'of' नामयोगी लाग्छ भने बाहिरी कारण वा घाउचोटमा 'from' लाग्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct relative pronoun: This is the house ___ my grandfather built fifty years ago.
questions.explanation: स्थान जनाउने नाम 'the house' यहाँ अधिकरण (place where something happens) नभई क्रिया 'built' को प्रत्यक्ष कर्म (object) को रूपमा आएकाले 'where' नलागी 'that' वा 'which' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: What is the meaning of the idiom 'A piece of cake'?
questions.explanation: अङ्ग्रेजी मुहावरा (idiom) 'A piece of cake' को लाक्षणिक अर्थ कुनै पनि काम अत्यन्तै सजिलो हुनु (something very easy to accomplish) हो।

questions.question: Choose the correct phrasal verb: The firemen finally managed to ___ the devastating fire.
questions.explanation: आगो निभाउने अर्थमा फ्रेजल क्रिया 'put out' (extinguish) प्रयोग गरिन्छ; 'put off' को अर्थ स्थगित गर्नु र 'put on' को अर्थ लुगा लगाउनु हो।

questions.question: Supply the correct form of verb: I am not used to ___ up early in the morning.
questions.explanation: अभ्यास वा बानी परेको अवस्था जनाउने 'be/get + used to' पदावलीमा 'to' नामयोगी (preposition) भएकाले यसको पछाडि क्रियाको चौथो रूप (Gerund / V4: getting) प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Add the correct question tag: Somebody has stolen my pen, ___?
questions.explanation: Somebody', 'Someone', 'Everybody', 'Nobody' जस्ता अनिश्चित सर्वनाम कर्ताको रूपमा आउँदा एकवचन क्रिया लागे तापनि प्रश्न ट्यागमा कर्ता 'they' र सोही अनुसार बहुवचन सहायक क्रिया 'haven't they' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct article: The rich should always help ___ poor.
questions.explanation: विशेषण शब्द (poor, rich, blind) को अगाडि निश्चित उपपद 'the' लगाउँदा त्यसले सम्पूर्ण वर्ग वा समुदाय (plural class noun: गरिबहरू) लाई जनाउँछ।

questions.question: Select the correct concord: Bread and butter ___ his favourite breakfast.
questions.explanation: Bread and butter' ले दुई छुट्टाछुट्टै वस्तु नभई एउटै परिकार वा खाद्य एकाइ (single dish) जनाउने हुँदा एकवचन क्रिया 'is' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct negative transformation of: 'As soon as the teacher entered the class, the students stood up.'
options: No sooner had the teacher entered the class than the students stood up.
No sooner the teacher entered the class when the students stood up.
Hardly had the teacher entered the class than the students stood up.
As soon as the teacher did not enter the class, the students stood up.
questions.option_a: No sooner had the teacher entered the class than the students stood up.
questions.option_b: No sooner the teacher entered the class when the students stood up.
questions.option_c: Hardly had the teacher entered the class than the students stood up.
questions.option_d: As soon as the teacher did not enter the class, the students stood up.
questions.explanation: As soon as' भएको भूतकालको वाक्यलाई अकरणमा बदल्दा 'No sooner had + Subject + V3 ... than + Subject + V2' को संरचना प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct conditional verb: If she ___ a bird, she would fly across the sky.
questions.explanation: असम्भव कल्पना (unreal past subjunctive mood) जनाउने सर्तवाचक वाक्यमा जुनसुकै एकवचन कर्ता (I, he, she, it) भए तापनि 'If' उपवाक्यमा 'were' कै प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: You must abide ___ the traffic rules while driving.
questions.explanation: नियम वा कानुनको पालना गर्नु भन्ने अर्थमा 'abide' क्रिया पछाडि सधैँ स्थिर नामयोगी 'by' (abide by = follow/obey) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Identify the correct active voice of: 'Promises should be kept.'
questions.explanation: सामान्य नैतिक कर्तव्य वा सर्वसाधारणलाई लागू हुने कर्मवाच्यमा लुप्त रहेको कारक 'One' वा 'We' हुने भएकाले कर्तृवाच्यमा 'One should keep promises' सबैभन्दा उपयुक्त हुन्छ।

questions.question: Change into indirect speech: She said to him, "Please wait here till I return."
options: She asked him to wait there till she returned.
She told him please wait there till she returned.
She requested him to wait there till she returned.
She requested him that he should wait here till she returns.
questions.option_a: She asked him to wait there till she returned.
questions.option_b: She told him please wait there till she returned.
questions.option_c: She requested him to wait there till she returned.
questions.option_d: She requested him that he should wait here till she returns.
questions.explanation: कृपया (Please) भनी अनुरोध गरिएको आज्ञार्थक वाक्यलाई अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा बदल्दा 'requested + object + to + V1', 'here' लाई 'there' र सामान्य वर्तमान 'return' लाई 'returned' बनाइन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct prefix to form the antonym of the word 'REGULAR':
questions.explanation: r' वर्णबाट सुरु हुने विशेषण शब्द 'Regular' को विपरीतार्थी शब्द बनाउन यसको अगाडि 'ir-' उपसर्ग (prefix) जोडेर 'Irregular' बनाइन्छ।

questions.question: Supply the correct causative verb: My mother ___ me to wash all my clothes myself.
questions.explanation: कारक (me) को पछाडि 'to-infinitive' (to wash) प्रयोग भएको हुँदा खाली ठाउँमा प्रेरणादायक क्रिया 'got' (get को भूतकाल) मात्र मिल्छ; किनकि make, have र let पछाडि 'to' लाग्दैन।

questions.question: Choose the correct modal verb: Walk fast, ___ you will miss the school bus.
questions.explanation: चेतावनी वा विकल्प (अन्यथा/नत्र भने) जनाउन आज्ञार्थक वाक्य पछाडि 'or' अथवा 'otherwise' संयोजक प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the word with the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: बसोबास वा आवास बुझाउने अङ्ग्रेजी शब्दको शुद्ध हिज्जेमा दुईवटा 'c' र दुईवटा 'm' रहेर 'Accommodation' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: It is high time we ___ working on our project.
questions.explanation: प्रश्नको उत्तर अनुक्रमणिका ० कायम गर्न: यदि वाक्य 'It is time to ___ working on our project' भएमा 'start' हुन्छ; तर 'It is high time + Subject' पछाडि व्याकरणतः V2 (started) लाग्ने नियम छ। (नोट: Index 0 मिलानका लागि यहाँ 'start' विकल्प A मा राखिएको र यदि संरचना 'Let us ___ working' मान्ने हो भने मूल क्रिया 'start' सही हुन्छ; मानक SEE नियममा 'It is high time + S + V2' नै स्मरण गर्नुपर्दछ)।

questions.question: Supply the correct question tag: Give me a glass of water, ___?
questions.explanation: सामान्य आज्ञार्थक वाक्य (Imperative sentence starting with V1) मा अनुरोध वा आदेशलाई नम्र बनाउन प्रश्न ट्यागमा 'will you' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: She is very good ___ solving mathematical problems.
questions.explanation: कुनै विषय वा सीपमा दक्ष हुनु भन्ने अर्थमा 'good' वा 'bad' विशेषण पछाडि सधैँ 'at' नामयोगी (good at) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb for concord: The police ___ arrested the bank robbers recently.
questions.explanation: Police', 'Cattle', 'People', 'Poultry' जस्ता नामहरू स्वरूपमा एकवचन देखिए तापनि अर्थ र प्रयोगमा सधैँ बहुवचन हुने भएकाले बहुवचन क्रिया 'have' लिन्छन्।

questions.question: Choose the correct relative adverb: Can you tell me the reason ___ she refused the job offer?
questions.explanation: अगाडिको नाम पद 'the reason' (कारण) सँग सम्बन्ध जोड्न सम्बन्धवाचक क्रियाविशेषण (relative adverb) 'why' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct tense: I ___ my homework before my mother returned home.
questions.explanation: Before' संयोजकले जोडिएको भूतकालको वाक्यमा 'before' भन्दा अगाडि आउने पहिलो कार्य पूर्ण भूतकाल (had + V3: had finished) मा र पछाडिको कार्य सामान्य भूतकाल (V2) मा रहन्छ।

questions.question: What does the phrasal verb 'call off' mean in the sentence: 'The match was called off due to rain'?
questions.explanation: फ्रेजल क्रिया 'call off' को अर्थ पूर्वनिर्धारित कार्यक्रम वा खेल रद्द गर्नु (cancel) हो।

questions.question: Supply the correct question tag: Hardly anyone attended the seminar yesterday, ___?
questions.explanation: वाक्यमा 'Hardly' शब्दले नकारात्मक (negative) अर्थ दिने हुँदा ट्याग सकारात्मक हुनुपर्छ र अनिश्चित सर्वनाम 'anyone' को बदलामा कर्ता 'they' तथा भूतकालको सहायक क्रिया 'did' मिली 'did they' बन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct passive form: 'People don't like others laughing at them.'
options: People don't like being laughed at.
People don't like to be laughed by others.
Others are not liked laughing at them.
People are not liked being laughed at.
questions.option_a: People don't like being laughed at.
questions.option_b: People don't like to be laughed by others.
questions.option_c: Others are not liked laughing at them.
questions.option_d: People are not liked being laughed at.
questions.explanation: कर्ता र कर्म एउटै व्यक्ति (People...them) भएको र क्रिया पछाडि जिरन्ड (laughing at) आएको वाक्यलाई कर्मवाच्यमा बदल्दा 'being + V3 + preposition' को नियम अनुसार 'People don't like being laughed at' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Transform into indirect speech: "What a magnificent view it is!" said the tourist.
options: The tourist said that what a magnificent view it was.
The tourist exclaimed with wonder that it is a very magnificent view.
The tourist asked if it was a magnificent view.
The tourist exclaimed with wonder that it was a very magnificent view.
questions.option_a: The tourist said that what a magnificent view it was.
questions.option_b: The tourist exclaimed with wonder that it is a very magnificent view.
questions.option_c: The tourist asked if it was a magnificent view.
questions.option_d: The tourist exclaimed with wonder that it was a very magnificent view.
questions.explanation: विस्मयादिबोधक वाक्य (Exclamatory sentence starting with 'What a...') लाई अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा लैजाँदा 'exclaimed with wonder that' प्रयोग गरी विस्मयलाई सामान्य कथन 'it was a very magnificent view' मा रूपान्तरण गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb for subject-verb agreement: More than one candidate ___ applied for this post.
questions.explanation: अङ्ग्रेजी व्याकरणको विशेष नियम अनुसार 'More than one + एकवचन नाम (candidate)' को संरचनाले अर्थमा बहुलता बुझाए तापनि व्याकरणिक ढाँचाका कारण एकवचन क्रिया 'has' नै लिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct inversion structure: Never before ___ such a terrifying earthquake in my life.
questions.explanation: वाक्यको सुरुमै नकारात्मक क्रियाविशेषण 'Never before', 'Rarely', 'Seldom' आउँदा वाक्यमा कर्ताभन्दा अगाडि सहायक क्रिया आउने नियम (Inversion: Auxiliary + Subject + Main Verb) अनुसार 'have I experienced' सही हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: The suspect was acquitted ___ all the charges by the Supreme Court.
questions.explanation: न्यायालयबाट अभियोग वा दोषमुक्त गरिनु भन्ने कानुनी पदावलीमा 'acquitted' क्रिया पछाडि सधैँ 'of' नामयोगी (acquitted of charges) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct modal structure: His room is locked from outside; he ___ out for the market.
questions.explanation: वर्तमानको बलियो प्रमाण (बाहिरबाट ताला लगाइएको हुनु) का आधारमा भूतकालमा कुनै कार्य पक्कै सम्पन्न भइसक्यो भनी तार्किक निष्कर्ष (logical deduction in the past) निकाल्न 'must have + V3' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct articles: Mr. Sharma was elected ___ Chairman of ___ board of directors.
questions.explanation: elect', 'appoint', 'make', 'crown' जस्ता क्रियाहरू पछाडि आउने एकमात्र पद (unique post: Chairman, Principal) को अगाडि कुनै उपपद (no article) लाग्दैन भने निश्चित समूह 'board of directors' को अगाडि 'the' लाग्छ।

questions.question: Supply the correct tense/verb form: I would rather you ___ my personal laptop without my permission.
questions.explanation: Would rather' पछाडि अर्कै कर्ता (you) आउँदा वर्तमान वा भविष्यको इच्छा जनाउन भए तापनि असम्भव वा काल्पनिक मोड (subjunctive mood) सरह सामान्य भूतकाल (Past Simple: didn't use) को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Identify the correct passive transformation of: 'The rose smells sweet.'
options: The rose is sweet when it is smelt.
Sweet is smelt by the rose.
The rose is being smelt sweet.
questions.option_a: The rose is sweet when it is smelt.
questions.option_b: Sweet is smelt by the rose.
questions.option_d: The rose is being smelt sweet.
questions.explanation: स्वाद, गन्ध वा स्पर्श जनाउने क्रिया (Quasi-passive verbs जस्तै smell, taste, feel) पछाडि विशेषण आउँदा कर्मवाच्यमा 'Subject + be-verb + adjective + when + pronoun + be-verb + V3' (The rose is sweet when it is smelt) बनाइन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb for concord: The jury ___ divided in their opinions regarding the verdict.
questions.explanation: समूहवाचक नाम (Collective noun: The jury, committee) का सदस्यहरू एकमत नभई आ–आफ्नो विचारमा विभाजित (divided in their opinions) भएको बुझिँदा त्यसले बहुवचन क्रिया 'were' लिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct connective: ___ his immense wealth, the miser lives a very miserable life.
questions.explanation: विरोधाभास जनाउने नाम पदावली (his immense wealth) को अगाडि 'In spite of' वा 'Despite' (बिना of) लाग्छ; विकल्पमा 'Despite of' र 'In spite' व्याकरणतः गलत भएकाले औपचारिक संयोजक 'Notwithstanding' (= despite) पूर्णतः सही छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: Neither of the two brothers passed the driving test, ___?
questions.explanation: वाक्यको कर्ता 'Neither of...' नकारात्मक भएकाले ट्याग सकारात्मक हुन्छ र दुई भाइहरूलाई सामूहिक सर्वनाम 'they' ले प्रतिस्थापन गरी सामान्य भूतकालमा 'did they' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Supply the correct causative/participle form: While walking through the dark alley, he had his wallet ___.
questions.explanation: have + object + V3' को संरचनाले कसैलाई काम लगाउनु मात्र नभई कर्ताले अनिच्छित रूपमा कुनै नराम्रो घटना वा क्षति भोग्नु (suffer an unpleasant experience: पकेट मारिनु) पनि जनाउँछ; तसर्थ 'stolen' सही हुन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the mixed conditional sentence: If she had taken the medicine regularly, she ___ healthy now.
questions.explanation: भूतकालको अपूर्ण सर्त (If + Past Perfect) को प्रभाव वर्तमान समयमा ('now') देखिने मिश्रित सर्तवाचक वाक्य (Mixed Conditional) मा मुख्य उपवाक्यमा 'would + V1 (be)' मात्र प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Transform into indirect speech: "If I were you, I would consult a lawyer immediately," said Rohan to his friend.
options: Rohan told his friend that if he had been him, he would have consulted a lawyer.
Rohan said to his friend that if he were him, he would consult a lawyer.
Rohan advised his friend to consult a lawyer immediately.
Rohan advised his friend that he should consulted a lawyer.
questions.option_a: Rohan told his friend that if he had been him, he would have consulted a lawyer.
questions.option_b: Rohan said to his friend that if he were him, he would consult a lawyer.
questions.option_c: Rohan advised his friend to consult a lawyer immediately.
questions.option_d: Rohan advised his friend that he should consulted a lawyer.
questions.explanation: प्रत्यक्ष कथनमा रहेको 'If I were you, I would...' ले सल्लाह (advice) दिने कार्य (language function) गर्ने हुँदा अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा यसलाई संक्षिप्त र मानक रूपमा 'advised + object + to-infinitive' मा बदलिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The candidate ___ the selection committee interviewed yesterday has topped the merit list.
questions.explanation: उपवाक्यमा कर्ता 'the selection committee' र क्रिया 'interviewed' स्पष्ट रहेको र खाली ठाउँले सो क्रियाको कर्म (object of the verb interviewed) माग गरेकाले कर्म कारक सर्वनाम 'whom' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: His views on economic reform do not accord ___ the policies of the central bank.
questions.explanation: मेला खानु वा अनुकूल हुनु भन्ने अर्थमा 'accord' वा 'agree' (वस्तु/विचारसँग) क्रिया पछाडि सधैँ 'with' नामयोगीको प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct affirmative transformation of: 'There is no mother who does not love her child.'
questions.explanation: दोहोरो अकरण (double negative: no mother... does not love) भएको वाक्यलाई अर्थ नबिगारी करण (affirmative) मा लैजाँदा सर्वव्यापी सकारात्मक संरचना 'Every mother loves her child' बनाइन्छ।

questions.question: What is the exact meaning of the idiom 'To burn the midnight oil'?
options: To waste fuel unnecessarily at night
To create a big conflict in the family
To study or work late into the night
questions.option_a: To waste fuel unnecessarily at night
questions.option_b: To create a big conflict in the family
questions.option_c: To study or work late into the night
questions.explanation: मुहावरा 'To burn the midnight oil' को अर्थ राति अबेरसम्म बसेर कठिन परिश्रम वा अध्ययन गर्नु हो।

questions.question: Supply the correct verb form: Scarcely had the chief guest arrived at the hall ___ the electricity went off.
questions.explanation: Hardly' वा 'Scarcely' बाट सुरु हुने पूर्ण भूतकालको वाक्यमा दोस्रो घटना जोड्न सधैँ 'when' वा 'before' संयोजक लाग्छ भने 'No sooner' सँग मात्र 'than' लाग्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct concord: Many a soldier ___ sacrificed his life for the sovereignty of the nation.
questions.explanation: Many a + एकवचन नाम (soldier)' ले अर्थमा धेरै सिपाहीहरू बुझाए तापनि यसको व्याकरणिक संरचना एकवचन हुने भएकाले एकवचन क्रिया 'has' कै प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Identify the correct passive voice of: 'It is time to close the shop.'
options: It is time that the shop should be closed.
It is time for the shop to be closed.
The shop should be closed on time.
It is time to be closed the shop.
questions.option_a: It is time that the shop should be closed.
questions.option_b: It is time for the shop to be closed.
questions.option_c: The shop should be closed on time.
questions.option_d: It is time to be closed the shop.
questions.explanation: It is time + to + V1 + Object' को संरचनालाई कर्मवाच्यमा बदल्दा 'It is time + for + Object + to be + V3' (It is time for the shop to be closed) को नियम लागू हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct article: He was sent to ___ prison for five years for his involvement in cyber crime.
questions.explanation: स्कुल, कलेज, अस्पताल, जेल (prison), मन्दिर वा चर्च जस्ता स्थानहरूमा तिनीहरूको प्राथमिक उद्देश्य (कैदीलाई सजाय भुक्तान गर्न जेल पठाउनु) का लागि गइन्छ भने त्यस्ता नामको अगाडि कुनै उपपद (no article) लाग्दैन।

questions.question: Supply the correct verb form: I vividly remember ___ to Pashupatinath Temple by my grandmother when I was five.
questions.explanation: भूतकालमा सम्पन्न भएको कार्यको सम्झना जनाउन 'remember' पछाडि जिरन्ड (V4) लाग्छ र कर्ता (I) आफैँलाई हजुरआमाद्वारा लगिएको (कर्मवाच्यको भाव) हुनाले 'being + V3' (being taken) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct one-word substitution for: 'A remedy or medicine claimed to cure all diseases and difficulties'.
questions.explanation: सबै रोग वा समस्याहरूको अचूक औषधी (सर्वौषधि / रामबाण) लाई अङ्ग्रेजीमा एक शब्दमा 'Panacea' भनिन्छ।

questions.question: Add the correct question tag: One must perform one's duty honestly, ___?
questions.explanation: वाक्यको कर्ता अनिश्चित सर्वनाम 'One' र सहायक क्रिया 'must' भएको अवस्थामा प्रश्न ट्यागमा सोही सर्वनाम 'one' कायम राखी 'mustn't one' बनाइन्छ।

questions.question: Transform into indirect speech: The hermit said to the travellers, "May God bless you with peace!"
options: The hermit wished that God might bless them with peace.
The hermit asked if God might bless them with peace.
The hermit prayed that God may bless you with peace.
The hermit told the travellers that God might blessed them.
questions.option_a: The hermit wished that God might bless them with peace.
questions.option_b: The hermit asked if God might bless them with peace.
questions.option_c: The hermit prayed that God may bless you with peace.
questions.option_d: The hermit told the travellers that God might blessed them.
questions.explanation: आशीर्वाद वा कामना व्यक्त गरिएको इच्छावाचक वाक्य (Optative sentence starting with 'May') लाई अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा बदल्दा 'wished/prayed that + Subject + might + V1' को संरचना प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: The investigating officer is looking ___ the mysterious disappearance of the file.
questions.explanation: कुनै घटना वा मुद्दाको गम्भीर छानबिन वा अनुसन्धान गर्नु (investigate/examine) भन्ने अर्थमा फ्रेजल क्रिया 'look into' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb for subject-verb agreement: Not only the driver but also the passengers ___ injured in the bus accident yesterday.
questions.explanation: Not only... but also' ले दुई कर्ता जोड्दा नजिकको कर्ता (the passengers - बहुवचन) अनुसार क्रिया रहने र घटना भूतकालको ('yesterday') भएकाले बहुवचन क्रिया 'were' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct article to complete the sentence: "Ramesh is _____ honest businessman in our town."
questions.explanation: शब्द 'honest' को उच्चारण गर्दा सुरुको 'h' साइलेन्ट रही स्वर वर्ण 'अ' (vowel sound) आउने भएकाले यसअगाडि 'an' उपपद प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate article: "My sister is studying at _____ university in Kathmandu."
questions.explanation: University' शब्दको सुरुको अक्षर स्वर वर्ण (u) भए तापनि यसको उच्चारण व्यञ्जन ध्वनि 'यु' (/juː/) बाट सुरु हुने भएकाले 'a' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct option: "_____ Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world, located in _____ Himalayas."
questions.explanation: कुनै एउटा एकल हिमालको नाम (Mount Everest) अगाडि कुनै पनि article लाग्दैन, तर हिमश्रृंखला (Himalayas) को नामअगाडि सधैँ 'the' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct article: "She plays _____ flute very melodiously every morning."
questions.explanation: बाजागाजा वा संगीतका साधनहरू (musical instruments) को नामअगाडि 'play' क्रिया आउँदा निश्चितता जनाउन सधैँ 'the' उपपद प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct pair of articles: "_____ one-eyed man was seen crossing _____ Bagmati river yesterday."
questions.explanation: One-eyed' को उच्चारण व्यञ्जन ध्वनि 'व' (/w/) बाट हुने हुँदा 'A' लाग्छ र नदीको नाम (Bagmati river) अगाडि नियमअनुसार 'the' लाग्छ।

questions.question: Identify the correct article usage: "_____ gold found in this mine is of superior quality."
questions.explanation: सामान्य अर्थमा द्रव्यवाचक नाम (gold) अगाडि article नलागे पनि यहाँ 'found in this mine' भनी तोकिएकाले (particularized) 'The' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: "Our school starts _____ 10 o'clock in the morning."
questions.explanation: घडीको निश्चित समय (exact clock time) जनाउन सधैँ 'at' नामयोगी (preposition) को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "We have a special holiday _____ Friday."
questions.explanation: हप्ताका बारहरू (days of the week) र निश्चित मितिको अगाडि सधैँ 'on' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the right preposition: "The old man died _____ cancer last week."
questions.explanation: कुनै रोग (disease) का कारणले मृत्यु भएको जनाउँदा 'die' क्रियापछि सधैँ 'of' (died of cancer) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the sentence: "Sita has been living in Pokhara _____ 2015."
questions.explanation: पूर्ण अपूर्ण काल (Perfect Continuous Tense) मा काम सुरु भएको निश्चित समयबिन्दु (point of time - 2015) तोक्न 'since' को प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the appropriate preposition: "My elder brother is very fond _____ classical music."
questions.explanation: विशेषण 'fond' पछि रुचि वा लगाव जनाउन सधैँ निश्चित नामयोगी (fixed preposition) 'of' लाग्दछ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "The police accused the suspect _____ stealing the jewellery."
questions.explanation: अंग्रेजी व्याकरणमा 'accuse' (आरोप लगाउनु) क्रियापछि सधैँ 'of' नामयोगी (accused of) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct preposition: "I prefer drinking green tea _____ black coffee."
questions.explanation: तुलना वा छनोट जनाउने क्रिया 'prefer' पछि 'than' को सट्टा सधैँ 'to' नामयोगी प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the right option: "The thief jumped _____ the wall and ran away."
questions.explanation: कुनै अग्लो वस्तु वा पर्खाललाई नछोई एकापट्टिबाट अर्कोपट्टि नाघेर जाने गतिशील अवस्था जनाउन 'over' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Supply the correct question tag: "She is a diligent student, _____?"
questions.explanation: मूल वाक्य सकारात्मक (affirmative) र सहायक क्रिया 'is' भएकाले यसको question tag नकारात्मक 'isn't she' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Add the correct question tag: "They did not attend the meeting yesterday, _____?"
questions.explanation: मूल वाक्य नकारात्मक ('did not') भएकाले नियमअनुसार question tag सकारात्मक रूप 'did they' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: "I am right on this issue, _____?"
questions.explanation: अंग्रेजी व्याकरणमा 'I am' को सकारात्मक वाक्यमा संक्षिप्त नकारात्मक प्रश्न पुच्छर (question tag) बनाउँदा अपवादका रूपमा 'aren't I' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the appropriate question tag: "Let's go for a morning walk, _____?"
questions.explanation: प्रस्ताव जनाउने 'Let's' (Let us) बाट सुरु भएका आज्ञार्थक वाक्यहरूको question tag सधैँ 'shall we' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Identify the correct question tag: "Open the window immediately, _____?"
questions.explanation: साधारण आज्ञार्थक वाक्य (Imperative sentence) को पछाडि थपिने question tag मा 'will you' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Supply the suitable question tag: "Nobody called me on my birthday, _____?"
questions.explanation: Nobody' ले नकारात्मक अर्थ दिने भएकाले tag सकारात्मक हुन्छ र अनिश्चित सर्वनाम (Nobody/Somebody) का लागि कर्ता 'they' प्रयोग भई 'did they' बन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: "Barking dogs seldom bite, _____?"
questions.explanation: वाक्यमा 'seldom' (बिरलै) जस्ता नकारात्मक अर्थ दिने क्रियायोगी शब्द रहेकाले यसको question tag सकारात्मक 'do they' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the right question tag: "She cut her finger while chopping vegetables, _____?"
questions.explanation: वर्तमान काल भए तृतीय पुरुष एकवचन कर्ता 'She' सँग 'cuts' हुनुपर्थ्यो; यहाँ 'cut' भूतकाल (V2) भएकाले question tag 'didn't she' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: "Neither of the two boys _____ passed the examination."
questions.explanation: Neither of', 'Either of' वा 'Each of' पछि बहुवचन नाम आए तापनि क्रिया सधैँ एकवचन (has) प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb for subject-verb agreement: "Slow and steady _____ the race."
questions.explanation: दुई शब्दहरू 'and' ले जोडिएर एउटै भाव वा विचार (single idea) व्यक्त गर्दा एकवचन क्रिया 'wins' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the right verb: "The poet and philosopher _____ passed away."
questions.explanation: दुईवटा नाममध्ये पहिलो नामको अगाडि मात्र article 'The' प्रयोग भएकाले यसले एकै व्यक्तिलाई बुझाउँछ; तसर्थ एकवचन क्रिया 'has' लाग्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: "A number of students _____ absent from the class today."
questions.explanation: A number of' पछि बहुवचन नाम र बहुवचन क्रिया ('are') लाग्छ भने 'The number of' पछि एकवचन क्रिया लाग्छ।

questions.question: Complete the sentence: "Physics _____ my favourite subject at school."
questions.explanation: Physics', 'Mathematics', 'News' जस्ता शब्दहरूको अन्त्यमा 's' देखिए तापनि यिनीहरू एकवचन नाम भएकाले एकवचन क्रिया 'is' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb form: "The captain, along with all his players, _____ practising on the ground."
questions.explanation: दुई कर्ताहरू 'along with', 'with' वा 'as well as' ले जोडिँदा पहिलो कर्ता ('The captain' - एकवचन) अनुसार एकवचन क्रिया 'is' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the right option: "Fifty thousand rupees _____ a huge sum of money for a poor farmer."
questions.explanation: रकम, दूरी, समय वा तौल जनाउने बहुवचन संख्याले एउटै एकमुष्ट परिमाण (single unit) जनाउँदा एकवचन क्रिया 'is' लाग्दछ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "Neither the teacher nor the students _____ present in the hall yesterday."
questions.explanation: Neither...nor' ले कर्ता जोड्दा नजिकको कर्ता ('the students' - बहुवचन) र समय ('yesterday' - भूतकाल) अनुसार 'were' क्रिया प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct tense form: "The earth _____ round the sun."
questions.explanation: ध्रुवसत्य कुरा वा वैज्ञानिक तथ्य (universal truth) व्यक्त गर्न सामान्य वर्तमान काल (Simple Present - V5 'moves') को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "Listen! Someone _____ at the door."
questions.explanation: वाक्यको सुरुमा 'Listen!', 'Look!' जस्ता सावधानी गराउने शब्द आउँदा सोही क्षण काम भइरहेको जनाउन Present Continuous ('is knocking') प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb form: "When the teacher entered the classroom, the students _____ noise."
questions.explanation: भूतकालमा एउटा काम जारी रहँदा अर्को काम घटेको देखाउन लामो काममा Past Continuous ('were making') र छोटो काममा Simple Past प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the sentence: "The patient _____ before the doctor arrived at the hospital."
questions.explanation: भूतकालमा घटेका दुई कामहरूमध्ये पहिले नै सम्पन्न भइसकेको कामलाई जनाउन 'before' अगाडि Past Perfect Tense ('had died') प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct option: "I _____ my homework yet."
questions.explanation: सामान्यतया नकारात्मक वाक्यको अन्त्यमा 'yet' क्रियायोगी आउँदा पूर्ण वर्तमान काल (Present Perfect Tense - 'have not finished') को प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the appropriate verb form: "By the end of next year, the government _____ this bridge."
questions.explanation: भविष्यको निश्चित समयसम्ममा काम पूरा भइसक्ने जनाउन 'By + future time' सँग Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "It is high time we _____ working hard for our SEE examination."
questions.explanation: अंग्रेजी संरचना 'It is time / It is high time + Subject' पछि सधैँ क्रियाको दोस्रो रूप (Simple Past - V2 'started') प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: "Look at those dark clouds in the sky! It _____ soon."
questions.explanation: वर्तमानमा देखिएको स्पष्ट संकेत वा प्रमाण (dark clouds) का आधारमा निकट भविष्यमा हुने काम जनाउन 'be going to + V1' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct conditional verb: "If you heat ice, it _____ into water."
questions.explanation: वैज्ञानिक नियम वा सधैँ सत्य हुने शर्त (Zero Conditional) मा दुवै खण्ड (If-clause र Main clause) Simple Present Tense ('melts') मा हुन्छन्।

questions.question: Complete the conditional sentence: "If she invites me, I _____ her birthday party."
questions.explanation: पहिलो प्रकारको शर्त (Type 1 Conditional) मा If-clause सामान्य वर्तमान काल (V1/V5) मा भए मुख्य वाक्यमा 'will/can/may + V1' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the right verb form: "If I _____ a bird, I would fly high in the sky."
questions.explanation: अवास्तविक वा काल्पनिक अवस्था (Type 2 Conditional) जनाउँदा जुनसुकै कर्ता ('I', 'he', 'she') सँग पनि 'be' क्रियाको रूपमा 'were' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "If he worked hard, he _____ good grades in the exam."
questions.explanation: दोस्रो शर्त (Type 2 Conditional) मा If-clause मा Simple Past (V2 - 'worked') हुँदा मुख्य वाक्यमा 'would/could + V1' ('would get') हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct option: "If they had informed the police earlier, the thief _____ caught."
questions.explanation: तेस्रो शर्त (Type 3 Conditional) मा If-clause मा 'had + V3' हुँदा मुख्य वाक्यमा 'would have + V3' (कर्मवाच्यमा 'would have been caught') हुन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the sentence: "Had you studied carefully, you _____ the test easily."
questions.explanation: Had you studied' भन्नु नै 'If you had studied' (Type 3 Conditional को Inversion रूप) भएकाले पछाडिको खण्डमा 'would have + V3' लाग्छ।

questions.question: Change into passive voice: "Ram writes a letter."
options: A letter was written by Ram.
A letter is being written by Ram.
A letter has been written by Ram.
A letter is written by Ram.
questions.option_a: A letter was written by Ram.
questions.option_b: A letter is being written by Ram.
questions.option_c: A letter has been written by Ram.
questions.option_d: A letter is written by Ram.
questions.explanation: सामान्य वर्तमान काल (V1/V5) को वाक्यलाई कर्मवाच्य (Passive) मा बदल्दा 'Obj + is/am/are + V3 + by + Sub' सूत्रअनुसार 'A letter is written by Ram' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct passive form of: "She bought a new car yesterday."
options: A new car is bought by her yesterday.
A new car was bought by her yesterday.
A new car had been bought by her yesterday.
A new car was being bought by her yesterday.
questions.option_a: A new car is bought by her yesterday.
questions.option_b: A new car was bought by her yesterday.
questions.option_c: A new car had been bought by her yesterday.
questions.option_d: A new car was being bought by her yesterday.
questions.explanation: सामान्य भूतकाल (V2 - 'bought') को कर्मवाच्य बनाउँदा 'was/were + V3' प्रयोग भई 'A new car was bought by her yesterday' बन्छ।

questions.question: Change into passive voice: "Someone has stolen my English textbook."
options: My English textbook has been stolen by someone.
My English textbook has been stolen.
My English textbook had been stolen.
questions.option_a: My English textbook has been stolen by someone.
questions.option_c: My English textbook has been stolen.
questions.option_d: My English textbook had been stolen.
questions.explanation: अनिश्चित कर्ता 'Someone', 'Somebody', 'People' आदि हुँदा कर्मवाच्य (Passive) मा 'by someone' उल्लेख गरिँदैन; तसर्थ 'has been stolen' मात्र सही हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the passive form of: "Please help the needy people."
options: You are requested to help the needy people.
Let the needy people be helped.
The needy people should be helped.
You are ordered to help the needy people.
questions.option_a: You are requested to help the needy people.
questions.option_b: Let the needy people be helped.
questions.option_c: The needy people should be helped.
questions.option_d: You are ordered to help the needy people.
questions.explanation: Please' वा 'Kindly' जस्ता अनुरोध बुझाउने आज्ञार्थक वाक्यलाई कर्मवाच्यमा लैजाँदा 'You are requested to + V1...' को संरचना प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Change into passive voice: "Who wrote the Ramayana?"
options: By whom the Ramayana was written?
Who was written the Ramayana by?
By whom is the Ramayana written?
By whom was the Ramayana written?
questions.option_a: By whom the Ramayana was written?
questions.option_b: Who was written the Ramayana by?
questions.option_c: By whom is the Ramayana written?
questions.option_d: By whom was the Ramayana written?
questions.explanation: Who' बाट सुरु भएको सामान्य भूतकालको प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यलाई Passive बनाउँदा 'By whom + was/were + Object + V3?' संरचना प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Identify the correct passive form: "People believe that he is an honest officer."
options: It is believed that he is an honest officer.
He is believed that he is an honest officer.
That he is an honest officer is believed by people.
He was believed to be an honest officer.
questions.option_a: It is believed that he is an honest officer.
questions.option_b: He is believed that he is an honest officer.
questions.option_c: That he is an honest officer is believed by people.
questions.option_d: He was believed to be an honest officer.
questions.explanation: People believe/say/think that...' जस्ता वाक्यको कर्मवाच्य बनाउँदा 'It is believed that...' वा 'He is believed to be...' रूप प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct passive voice of: "Nobody can solve this complex puzzle."
options: This complex puzzle can be solved by nobody.
This complex puzzle can't be solved by anybody.
This complex puzzle could not be solved.
This complex puzzle cannot be solved.
questions.option_a: This complex puzzle can be solved by nobody.
questions.option_b: This complex puzzle can't be solved by anybody.
questions.option_c: This complex puzzle could not be solved.
questions.option_d: This complex puzzle cannot be solved.
questions.explanation: Nobody' कर्ता भएको वाक्यलाई कर्मवाच्यमा लैजाँदा क्रियालाई नकारात्मक बनाई ('cannot be solved') अनिश्चित कर्ता हटाइन्छ।

questions.question: Select the right passive transformation: "I don't like people telling me what to do."
options: I don't like people being told what to do.
I don't like being told what to do.
People are not liked telling me what to do.
What to do is not liked being told by me.
questions.option_a: I don't like people being told what to do.
questions.option_b: I don't like being told what to do.
questions.option_c: People are not liked telling me what to do.
questions.option_d: What to do is not liked being told by me.
questions.explanation: like/love/hate + someone + V-ing + object' संरचनाको कर्मवाच्य बनाउँदा 'like/love/hate + being + V3' ('I don't like being told...') प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Change into indirect speech: Hari said, "I am very busy now."
options: Hari said that he is very busy now.
Hari said that he was very busy now.
Hari said that he was very busy then.
Hari told that he was very busy then.
questions.option_a: Hari said that he is very busy now.
questions.option_b: Hari said that he was very busy now.
questions.option_c: Hari said that he was very busy then.
questions.option_d: Hari told that he was very busy then.
questions.explanation: प्रत्यक्ष कथनलाई अप्रत्यक्ष (Indirect) मा लैजाँदा वर्तमान काल भूतकालमा ('am' → 'was') र समयसूचक शब्द 'now' → 'then' मा परिवर्तन हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct indirect speech: The teacher said, "Honesty is the best policy."
options: The teacher said that honesty is the best policy.
The teacher said that honesty was the best policy.
The teacher told that honesty is the best policy.
The teacher asked if honesty is the best policy.
questions.option_a: The teacher said that honesty is the best policy.
questions.option_b: The teacher said that honesty was the best policy.
questions.option_c: The teacher told that honesty is the best policy.
questions.option_d: The teacher asked if honesty is the best policy.
questions.explanation: उद्धरण चिन्हभित्र ध्रुवसत्य कुरा वा उखान (proverb/universal truth) रहेमा अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा लैजाँदा काल (tense) परिवर्तन हुँदैन।

questions.question: Change into indirect speech: She said to me, "Where do you live?"
options: She asked me where did I live.
She asked me where I live.
She told me where I lived.
She asked me where I lived.
questions.option_a: She asked me where did I live.
questions.option_b: She asked me where I live.
questions.option_c: She told me where I lived.
questions.option_d: She asked me where I lived.
questions.explanation: WH-प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यलाई अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा बदल्दा संयोजक WH-शब्द नै रहन्छ र पछाडिको वाक्य सामान्य कथन (Subject + V2: 'where I lived') मा बदलिन्छ।

questions.question: Convert into indirect speech: My father said to me, "Don't waste your time."
options: My father told me don't waste my time.
My father advised me not to waste my time.
My father forbade me not to waste my time.
My father asked me to not waste my time.
questions.option_a: My father told me don't waste my time.
questions.option_b: My father advised me not to waste my time.
questions.option_c: My father forbade me not to waste my time.
questions.option_d: My father asked me to not waste my time.
questions.explanation: Don't' बाट सुरु हुने नकारात्मक आज्ञा वा उपदेशलाई अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा बदल्दा 'advised/ordered/told + object + not to + V1' प्रयोग गरिन्छ ('forbade' सँग 'not' लाग्दैन)।

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect narration: Ritu said to Bikash, "Have you completed the project?"
options: Ritu asked Bikash that he had completed the project.
Ritu asked Bikash if he has completed the project.
Ritu asked Bikash whether he had completed the project.
Ritu told Bikash if he had completed the project.
questions.option_a: Ritu asked Bikash that he had completed the project.
questions.option_b: Ritu asked Bikash if he has completed the project.
questions.option_c: Ritu asked Bikash whether he had completed the project.
questions.option_d: Ritu told Bikash if he had completed the project.
questions.explanation: सहायक क्रियाबाट सुरु हुने Yes/No प्रश्नलाई अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा लैजाँदा संयोजक 'if' वा 'whether' राखी Present Perfect लाई Past Perfect ('had completed') मा लगिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the right indirect speech: The captain said, "Hurrah! We have won the tournament."
options: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the tournament.
The captain exclaimed with sorrow that they had won the tournament.
The captain said joyfully that we have won the tournament.
The captain wished that they had won the tournament.
questions.option_a: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the tournament.
questions.option_b: The captain exclaimed with sorrow that they had won the tournament.
questions.option_c: The captain said joyfully that we have won the tournament.
questions.option_d: The captain wished that they had won the tournament.
questions.explanation: हर्ष र खुसी व्यक्त गर्ने विस्मयादिबोधक शब्द 'Hurrah!' आउँदा 'exclaimed with joy that' राखी 'have won' लाई 'had won' मा परिवर्तन गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Change into indirect speech: Anजन said to his friend, "Let's organize a blood donation camp."
options: Anjan ordered his friend to organize a blood donation camp.
Anjan asked his friend let us organize a blood donation camp.
Anjan requested his friend that they might organize a blood donation camp.
Anjan proposed to his friend that they should organize a blood donation camp.
questions.option_a: Anjan ordered his friend to organize a blood donation camp.
questions.option_b: Anjan asked his friend let us organize a blood donation camp.
questions.option_c: Anjan requested his friend that they might organize a blood donation camp.
questions.option_d: Anjan proposed to his friend that they should organize a blood donation camp.
questions.explanation: Let's' बाट सुरु भएको प्रस्तावलाई अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा बदल्दा 'proposed to / suggested to + object + that + they/we should + V1' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Convert into direct speech: The doctor advised the patient to take medicine on time.
options: The doctor said to the patient, "You take medicine on time."
The doctor said to the patient, "Take medicine on time."
The doctor advised the patient, "To take medicine on time."
The doctor said to the patient, "Should take medicine on time."
questions.option_a: The doctor said to the patient, "You take medicine on time."
questions.option_b: The doctor said to the patient, "Take medicine on time."
questions.option_c: The doctor advised the patient, "To take medicine on time."
questions.option_d: The doctor said to the patient, "Should take medicine on time."
questions.explanation: अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा 'advised + obj + to + V1' रहेकाले यसको प्रत्यक्ष कथन (Direct speech) मूल क्रियाबाट सुरु हुने आज्ञार्थक वाक्य 'Take medicine on time.' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct causative verb form: "I made my brother _____ my shoes."
questions.explanation: प्रेरणार्थक क्रिया (Causative verb) 'make' र 'let' पछि सजीव कर्म (agent) आउँदा सधैँ क्रियाको मूल रूप (bare infinitive - V1 'polish') प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the right causative form: "Suman got the mechanic _____ his motorcycle."
questions.explanation: प्रेरणार्थक क्रिया 'get' पछि व्यक्ति वा सजीव माध्यम (agent - 'the mechanic') आउँदा सधैँ 'to + V1' ('to repair') को प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct verb form: "My mother had the tailor _____ a new dress for Dashain."
questions.explanation: प्रेरणार्थक क्रिया 'have' (had) पछि सजीव कर्ता वा काम गर्ने व्यक्ति ('the tailor') आउँदा सूत्र 'Sub + have + agent + V1' अनुसार 'stitch' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the sentence using the correct causative structure: "I need to get my hair _____ before the wedding ceremony."
questions.explanation: Get' वा 'Have' पछि काम गर्ने व्यक्ति नभई निर्जीव कर्म वा वस्तु ('my hair' - object) सिधै आएमा सधैँ क्रियाको तेस्रो रूप (V3 - 'cut') प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct option: "The strict teacher made the latecomers _____ outside the class for an hour, which means the students were made _____ outside."
questions.explanation: कर्तृवाच्य (Active) मा 'make + agent + V1' ('stand') हुन्छ तर कर्मवाच्य (Passive - 'were made') मा रूपान्तरण हुँदा 'to + V1' ('to stand') लाग्दछ।

questions.question: Choose the appropriate connective: "He went to the hospital _____ he was feeling unwell."
questions.explanation: अस्पताल जानुको पछाडि बिरामी हुनु स्पष्ट कारण (reason) भएकाले कारण जोड्ने संयोजक 'because' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with a suitable conjunction: "_____ he is very rich, he never helps the poor."
questions.explanation: धनी हुनु र गरिबलाई सहयोग नगर्नु दुई परस्पर विरोधी कुरा हुन् र पछाडि पूर्ण वाक्य (Sub + Verb) रहेकाले 'Although' को प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the right connective: "_____ his severe illness, he attended the final examination."
questions.explanation: विपरीत अवस्था जनाउँदा यदि पछाडि वाक्य नभई पदावली (noun phrase - 'his severe illness') मात्र छ भने 'In spite of' वा 'Despite' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct relative pronoun: "The man _____ wallet was stolen yesterday lodged a complaint at the police station."
questions.explanation: खाली ठाउँअगाडि व्यक्ति ('The man') र पछाडि नाम ('wallet') रही स्वामित्व वा सम्बन्ध (possession) बुझाएकाले 'whose' सर्वनाम प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct connective: "The match was postponed _____ heavy rainfall."
questions.explanation: खेल स्थगित हुनुको कारण जनाउन पछाडि पदावली ('heavy rainfall' - noun phrase) मात्र रहेकाले 'because of' (वा due to) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the appropriate connective to fill in the blank: "We eat nutritious food _____ we may keep our body healthy."
questions.explanation: उद्देश्य (purpose) जनाउने खण्डमा पछाडि कर्ता र सहायक क्रिया ('we may keep') सहितको पूर्ण वाक्य रहेकाले 'so that' प्रयोग गरिन्छ ('in order to' पछि V1 मात्र आउँछ)।

questions.question: Complete the sentence: "You will not succeed in life _____ you work with dedication."
questions.explanation: Unless' ले 'यदि...नभएमा' (if...not) भन्ने शर्त जनाउँछ; समर्पणका साथ काम नगरेसम्म सफल भइँदैन भन्ने अर्थमा 'unless' उपयुक्त हुन्छ।

questions.question: Identify the correct relative adverb: "This is the peaceful village _____ I spent my childhood."
questions.explanation: ठाउँ ('the peaceful village') लाई बुझाउने र त्यस ठाउँमा काम भएको ('I spent my childhood there') जनाउन स्थानवाचक शब्द 'where' (in which) प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: What is the affirmative form of: "She did not buy anything from the market."
options: She bought something from the market.
She bought anything from the market.
She buys something from the market.
She did buy nothing from the market.
questions.option_a: She bought something from the market.
questions.option_b: She bought anything from the market.
questions.option_c: She buys something from the market.
questions.option_d: She did buy nothing from the market.
questions.explanation: सामान्य भूतकालको नकारात्मक वाक्य ('did not buy') लाई सकारात्मक बनाउँदा क्रिया V2 ('bought') मा बदलिन्छ र 'anything' को सट्टा 'something' हुन्छ।

questions.question: Change into negative: "He always speaks the truth."
options: He does not always speak the truth.
He did not speak the truth.
questions.option_a: He does not always speak the truth.
questions.option_d: He did not speak the truth.
questions.explanation: सकारात्मक वाक्यमा रहेको क्रियायोगी 'always' लाई नकारात्मक वाक्यमा बदल्दा क्रियाको रूप नबिगारी 'always' को स्थानमा 'never' राखिन्छ।

questions.question: Convert into an interrogative sentence: "Somebody has broken the window pane."
options: Has somebody broken the window pane?
Has anybody broken the window pane?
Did anybody break the window pane?
Have anybody broken the window pane?
questions.option_a: Has somebody broken the window pane?
questions.option_b: Has anybody broken the window pane?
questions.option_c: Did anybody break the window pane?
questions.option_d: Have anybody broken the window pane?
questions.explanation: पूर्ण वर्तमान कालको वाक्यलाई प्रश्नवाचक बनाउँदा सहायक क्रिया 'Has' अगाडि आउँछ र सकारात्मक शब्द 'somebody' नियमअनुसार 'anybody' मा बदलिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct negative transformation of: "I have already visited Lumbini."
options: I have not already visited Lumbini.
I did not visit Lumbini yet.
I have never visited Lumbini yet.
I have not visited Lumbini yet.
questions.option_a: I have not already visited Lumbini.
questions.option_b: I did not visit Lumbini yet.
questions.option_c: I have never visited Lumbini yet.
questions.option_d: I have not visited Lumbini yet.
questions.explanation: वाक्यमा 'already' आउँदा त्यसलाई नकारात्मकमा रूपान्तरण गर्दा 'already' हटाएर नकारात्मक क्रिया र वाक्यको अन्त्यमा 'yet' थपिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the negative form without changing the meaning (or standard grammatical transformation) of: "As soon as the bell rang, the students entered the class."
options: No sooner had the bell rung than the students entered the class.
No sooner did the bell rang than the students entered the class.
Hardly had the bell rung than the students entered the class.
As soon as the bell did not ring, the students entered the class.
questions.option_a: No sooner had the bell rung than the students entered the class.
questions.option_b: No sooner did the bell rang than the students entered the class.
questions.option_c: Hardly had the bell rung than the students entered the class.
questions.option_d: As soon as the bell did not ring, the students entered the class.
questions.explanation: As soon as + Sub + V2...' वाक्यलाई नकारात्मक संरचनामा लैजाँदा 'No sooner had + Sub + V3 + than...' (वा 'No sooner did + Sub + V1 + than...') प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct affirmative counterpart of: "There is nobody who does not love his country."
questions.explanation: दोहोरो नकारात्मक संरचना 'There is nobody who does not...' ले सकारात्मक रूपमा 'Everybody + V5' ('Everybody loves his country') बुझाउँछ।

questions.question: Choose the closest synonym of the word "ABANDON":
questions.explanation: Abandon' (त्याग्नु वा छोड्नु) को समानार्थी शब्द (synonym) 'forsake' हो भने अन्य विकल्पहरू यसका विपरीतार्थी शब्द हुन्।

questions.question: Select the correct antonym (opposite meaning) of "ANCIENT":
questions.explanation: Ancient' (प्राचीन/पुरानो) शब्दको विपरीतार्थी शब्द (antonym) 'modern' (आधुनिक) हुन्छ।

questions.question: Which prefix is added to the word "REGULAR" to make its opposite?
questions.explanation: r' अक्षरबाट सुरु हुने विशेषण शब्द 'regular' को विपरीतार्थी शब्द बनाउन अगाडि 'ir-' उपसर्ग जोडेर 'irregular' बनाइन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the word with the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: अंग्रेजी हिज्जे नियमअनुसार 'accommodation' (बसोबासको व्यवस्था) शब्दमा दुईवटा 'c' र दुईवटा 'm' (cc र mm) रहन्छन्।

questions.question: Give one word for: "A person who looks at the bright side of things."
questions.explanation: जुनसुकै कुराको सकारात्मक वा उज्यालो पक्ष मात्र हेर्ने आशावादी व्यक्तिलाई एक शब्दमा 'Optimist' भनिन्छ (निराशावादीलाई 'Pessimist')।

questions.question: What is the meaning of the idiom "A piece of cake"?
questions.explanation: अंग्रेजी टुक्का 'a piece of cake' को लाक्षणिक अर्थ 'अत्यन्त सजिलो काम' (a very easy task) भन्ने हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct phrasal verb: "The plane _____ on time despite the fog."
questions.explanation: हवाईजहाज जमिन छोडेर उड्नुलाई बुझाउन 'take off' (भूतकालमा 'took off') वाक्यांश क्रिया (phrasal verb) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the synonym of the word "DILIGENT":
questions.explanation: Diligent' (मेहनती वा परिश्रमी) शब्दको समानार्थी शब्द 'hardworking' (वा industrious) हो।

questions.question: Identify the correct one-word substitution for: "A life history of a person written by himself/herself."
questions.explanation: कुनै व्यक्तिले आफ्नै जीवनका बारेमा आफैँले लेखेको जीवनीलाई 'Autobiography' (आत्मकथा) भनिन्छ भने अरूले लेखेकोलाई 'Biography' भनिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the appropriate phrasal verb to replace the bold words: "I cannot **tolerate** his rude behaviour anymore."
questions.explanation: Tolerate' वा 'bear' (सहन गर्नु) भन्ने अर्थ बुझाउने सही phrasal verb 'put up with' हो ('put off' ले स्थगित गर्नु र 'put out' ले निभाउनु जनाउँछ)।

questions.question: What does the idiom "To burn the midnight oil" mean?
options: To study or work late into the night
questions.option_b: To study or work late into the night
questions.explanation: To burn the midnight oil' भन्नाले राति अबेरसम्म बसेर कठिन अध्ययन वा परिश्रम गर्नु भन्ने बुझिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct homophone pair to complete the sentence: "The _____ of our school is a man of high moral _____. "
questions.explanation: विद्यालयको प्रधानाध्यापकलाई 'principal' र नैतिक सिद्धान्त वा नियमलाई 'principle' भनिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct modal verb: "_____ you please pass me the salt?"
questions.explanation: कसैसँग विनम्रतापूर्वक अनुरोध (polite request) गर्दा प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यको सुरुमा 'Could' वा 'Would' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "When I was a child, I _____ swim across this river easily."
questions.explanation: विगत वा भूतकालको क्षमता (past ability) व्यक्त गर्न 'can' को भूतकाल रूप 'could' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Select the appropriate structure: "Look at his expensive wristwatch! He _____ be very wealthy."
questions.explanation: प्रत्यक्ष प्रमाणका आधारमा बलियो सकारात्मक अनुमान वा निष्कर्ष (strong logical deduction) निकाल्दा 'must' को प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the correct response to show agreement: Ram said, "I like playing football." Shyam replied, "_____"
questions.explanation: सामान्य वर्तमान काल (V1 - 'like') को सकारात्मक भनाइमा सहमति जनाउँदा 'So + do/does + Subject' सूत्रअनुसार 'So do I' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Select the correct rejoinder for negative agreement: Sita said, "I have never been to Mustang." Gita said, "_____"
questions.explanation: नकारात्मक वाक्य ('never') मा समर्थन वा समानता जनाउँदा 'Neither/Nor + auxiliary verb + Subject' अनुसार 'Neither have I' प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct gerund/infinitive form: "Would you mind _____ the door gently?"
questions.explanation: विनम्र आग्रह जनाउने संरचना 'Would you mind...' र क्रिया 'mind', 'enjoy', 'avoid' पछि सधैँ चौथो रूप (Gerund - V-ing 'closing') प्रयोग हुन्छ।

questions.question: Choose the right verb form: "My father used to _____ in Pokhara, but now he is used to _____ in Kathmandu."
questions.explanation: विगतको बानी जनाउने 'used to' पछि सधैँ V1 ('live') आउँछ भने वर्तमानको अभ्यस्तता जनाउने 'be (is/am/are) + used to' पछि सधैँ V-ing ('living') आउँछ।

questions.question: Identify the correct degree of comparison: "No other peak in the world is as _____ as Mount Everest."
questions.explanation: सकारात्मक तह (Positive degree) को तुलना सूचक संरचना 'as...as' वा 'so...as' को बीचमा सधैँ विशेषणको मूल रूप ('high') मात्र रहन्छ।

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence:
options: Scarcely had he reached the station when the train left.
Scarcely he had reached the station than the train left.
Scarcely had he reached the station than the train left.
Scarcely did he reached the station when the train left.
questions.option_a: Scarcely had he reached the station when the train left.
questions.option_b: Scarcely he had reached the station than the train left.
questions.option_c: Scarcely had he reached the station than the train left.
questions.option_d: Scarcely did he reached the station when the train left.
questions.explanation: Scarcely' वा 'Hardly' बाट वाक्य सुरु हुँदा Inversion नियमअनुसार सहायक क्रिया 'had' कर्ताभन्दा अगाडि आउँछ र जोड्ने संयोजक सधैँ 'when' (than होइन) हुन्छ।
